name: yf_insider_purchases
description:
Six-month summary of insider buying and selling for one stock from Yahoo Finance (yfinance insider_purchases).
Returns: {symbol, purchases: [{Insider Purchases Last 6m (row label such as Purchases, Sales, Net Shares Purchased (Sold), Total Insider Shares Held), Shares, Trans}]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Individual trades: yf_insider_transactions.
Example: {"symbol": "TSLA"}
